task_title: Non-blocking PR disposition: auto-close duplicates + quarantine abandon-candidates

plan_review.notes: Alt A: event-driven (rejected: higher GitHub Actions complexity, event ordering with batch sweeps). Alt B: git/patch-based proof only (rejected: LINKED_ISSUE_SIBLING + EMPTY_DIFF cover the real incident cases without per-PR compare calls). Alt C: quarantine-only (rejected: empty-diff auto-close is provably correct and reduces human load). Blocking concerns addressed: (1) revival anchored to post-quarantine comments; (2) EMPTY_DIFF uses pulls.get not list; (3) scope expanded to all open non-terminated PRs; (4) SIBLING_MERGED demoted to quarantine evidence not auto-close. Non-blocking: pagination fixed; stale trigger requires closed issue; pathToFileURL used. divergence=minor (design unchanged, 4 blocking defects corrected).
